name: Create Your Own Planetball!
desc:
Have you ever wanted to create a planetball morph, but all the games you tried don't have a morph editor that's good enough? This game is right for you!
You can edit and save any planetballs you want, and roleplay with them after.

Update 3.2.5
- Replaced the old size selection in the menu.
- Added a new lobby with image boards.
- Spin speed is now customizable in Editor +
- Added Battling

TAGS: planetball, roleplay, rp, planet, space, solarball, solarballs, planetballs, oc creator, CYOPB, create your own planetball
